description: This file defines dependency classes used within Apache Spark, including base classes for dependencies, narrow dependencies, and specific dependencies like shuffle, one-to-one, and range dependencies. It also includes the ShuffleDependency class with shuffle management logic.

classes.name: Dependency
classes.description: Abstract base class for dependencies in Spark.

classes.name: NarrowDependency
classes.description: Abstract class for dependencies where each child partition depends on a small number of parent partitions.

classes.name: ShuffleDependency
classes.description: Represents a dependency on the output of a shuffle stage, managing shuffle-specific details and state.

classes.name: OneToOneDependency
classes.description: Represents a one-to-one dependency between parent and child RDD partitions.

classes.name: RangeDependency
classes.description: Represents a dependency between ranges of partitions in parent and child RDDs.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Returns the parent partitions for a given child partition.

methods.name: setShuffleMergeAllowed
methods.description: Sets whether shuffle merge is allowed.

methods.name: shuffleMergeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if shuffle merge is enabled.

methods.name: shuffleMergeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if shuffle merge is allowed.

methods.name: setMergerLocs
methods.description: Sets the locations of external shuffle services for merge requests.

methods.name: getMergerLocs
methods.description: Retrieves the locations of external shuffle services.

methods.name: markShuffleMergeFinalized
methods.description: Marks the shuffle merge as finalized.

methods.name: isShuffleMergeFinalizedMarked
methods.description: Checks if the shuffle merge has been marked as finalized.

methods.name: shuffleMergeFinalized
methods.description: Returns true if shuffle merge is finalized or disabled.

methods.name: newShuffleMergeState
methods.description: Resets shuffle merge state for a new merge process.

methods.name: canShuffleMergeBeEnabled
methods.description: Determines if shuffle merge can be enabled based on configuration and stage type.

methods.name: incPushCompleted
methods.description: Marks a map task as push completed and returns the count of completed pushes.

methods.name: getFinalizeTask
methods.description: Retrieves the scheduled finalize task for shuffle merge.

methods.name: setFinalizeTask
methods.description: Sets the scheduled finalize task for shuffle merge.
